would write {{plist}}:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0">
<dict>
	<key>Label</key>
	<string>gh-board.watch</string>
	<key>ProgramArguments</key>
	<array>
		<string>{{bin}}</string>
		<string>watch</string>
		<string>--once</string>
		<string>--project</string>
		<string>acme/7</string>
	</array>
	<key>StartInterval</key>
	<integer>600</integer>
	<key>RunAtLoad</key>
	<true/>
	<key>EnvironmentVariables</key>
	<dict>
		<key>GH_PATH</key>
		<string>/opt/homebrew/bin/gh</string>
	</dict>
	<key>StandardOutPath</key>
	<string>{{log}}</string>
	<key>StandardErrorPath</key>
	<string>{{log}}</string>
</dict>
</plist>
would run launchctl bootout gui/501/gh-board.watch
would run launchctl bootstrap gui/501 {{plist}}
